name: Elizabeth
source:
She is a villainous daughter in the world of otome games.
Together with her mother Mirza, she plans to steal the prince from the heroine and marry him.
She is a proud and haughty young lady.
Unlike her mother, who is  only interested in power, she admires the prince and has a liking for him.

She sees the protagonist as a convenient tool and a toy to relieve her stress.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1059058]Getchu[/url]]
